declarations.name: MoviElement
declarations.description:
Movi Player — a WASM + WebCodecs video player custom element.

Plays formats the browser cannot (MKV, HEVC, AV1, TrueHD/DTS, …) on a WebGL2 canvas, with adaptive quality, HDR, subtitles and a full built-in UI.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Specifies the video source URL or File object.

attributes.name: autopictureinpicture
attributes.description: Enter Picture-in-Picture automatically when the tab is hidden, and leave it on

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Starts playback automatically when loaded.

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: Shows/hides the built-in UI controls.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Restarts playback when video ends.

attributes.name: muted
attributes.description: Mutes audio by default.

attributes.name: playsinline
attributes.description: Prevents auto-fullscreen on iOS (plays inline instead). It also — on **any touch

attributes.name: preload
attributes.description: Hints how much data to buffer initially.

attributes.name: probesize
attributes.description: How far the demuxer may read before it says what the streams are.

attributes.name: probeduration
attributes.description: How much media the demuxer may analyse before it says what the streams are, in

attributes.name: poster
attributes.description: Displays an image before playback starts.

attributes.name: posterfit
attributes.description: How the poster is fitted, when it should not be fitted the way the video is.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Sets element dimensions (CSS preferred).

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Sets element dimensions (CSS preferred).

attributes.name: crossorigin
attributes.description: CORS mode for cross-origin videos.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Sets the initial audio volume (0.0 to 1.0). User preference persists across reloads via OPFS and overrides this default on subsequent loads.

attributes.name: playbackrate
attributes.description: Sets the initial playback speed. Persists across reloads like `volume`.

attributes.name: subtitledelay
attributes.description: Shifts subtitle timing relative to video, in seconds. Sign matches VLC and mpv: **positive** values shift subtitles **later**, negative shifts them earlier.

attributes.name: subtitlesize
attributes.description: Subtitle size multiplier

attributes.name: subtitlecolor
attributes.description: Subtitle text color

attributes.name: subtitlebg
attributes.description: Subtitle background opacity (0..1)

attributes.name: subtitleedge
attributes.description: Subtitle edge style

attributes.name: ambientmode
attributes.description: Enables ambient background effects.

attributes.name: ambientwrapper
attributes.description: Specifies external element for ambient effects.

attributes.name: cropbars
attributes.description: Crops the black bars that are part of the **picture**.

attributes.name: backgroundplay
attributes.description: Lets [`autoplay`](#autoplay) start while the tab is **hidden**.

attributes.name: bindav
attributes.description: Stalls the sound and the picture **together**. On by default.

attributes.name: renderer
attributes.description: Chooses the rendering backend.

attributes.name: objectfit
attributes.description: Controls how video fills the canvas.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.description: Rotate video, in degrees (snaps to a quarter-turn)

attributes.name: thumb
attributes.description: Generates thumbnails on demand (used internally for preview).

attributes.name: hdr
attributes.description: Enables/disables HDR rendering.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Sets the UI theme.

attributes.name: sw
attributes.description: Forces software decoding (using FFmpeg WASM) instead of hardware-accelerated WebCodecs.

attributes.name: fps
attributes.description: Overrides the video frame rate with a custom value.

attributes.name: gesturefs
attributes.description: **Deprecated** — use `playsinline`

attributes.name: nohotkeys
attributes.description: Disables all keyboard shortcuts for playback control.

attributes.name: startat
attributes.description: Specifies the time (in seconds) where playback should start.

attributes.name: fastseek
attributes.description: Enables fast seek controls for quick ±10s navigation.

attributes.name: doubletap
attributes.description: Enables/disables double-tap to seek gesture.

attributes.name: themecolor
attributes.description: Sets the player's accent colors — one or two, separated by a space.

attributes.name: buffersize
attributes.description: Target prefetch window in **megabytes** — how far ahead of playback the source should try to keep buffered.

attributes.name: spinnerdelay
attributes.description: How long an interruption has to last, in **seconds**, before the viewer is shown a loading spinner.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Sets the video title shown in the in-player overlay. Unlike the global HTML `title` attribute, this does **not** trigger a native browser tooltip on hover.

attributes.name: showtitle
attributes.description: Shows the title bar overlay at the top of the player.

attributes.name: titlemode
attributes.description: Decides where the title bar is allowed to appear, and whether it carries a back arrow. Space- or comma-separated tokens, in any order:

attributes.name: chapters
attributes.description: Chapters that aren't in the media file. The player already reads chapter atoms out of MKV/MP4 containers; this is for the sources that keep them somewhere else — YouTube in the watch page, a CMS in its own database. Each entry is `{title, start, end?, image?}`, where `image` is artwork the timeline tile shows in place of a frame decoded at `start`.

attributes.name: resume
attributes.description: Saves playback position to localStorage and shows a resume dialog on reload.

attributes.name: stablevolume
attributes.description: Enables loudness normalization (DynamicsCompressorNode). Reduces loud scenes and boosts quiet ones.

attributes.name: encrypted
attributes.description: Enables encrypted video playback. Requires `tokenurl` and `videourl` attributes.

attributes.name: tokenurl
attributes.description: Token endpoint URL for encrypted playback. Server returns HMAC signing secret and file metadata.

attributes.name: videourl
attributes.description: Video endpoint URL for encrypted playback. Chunks are served with token + HMAC validation.

attributes.name: videoid
attributes.description: Video identifier sent to the token server. Maps to a specific encrypted file on the server.

attributes.name: drm
attributes.description: Enables DRM playback mode for HLS streams. When set, the player switches to a native `<video>` element + EME API instead of the canvas pipeline. Canvas-only features (rotation, snapshots) are disabled in this mode.

attributes.name: licenseurl
attributes.description: Widevine/FairPlay license server URL for DRM playback. Required when `drm` is set.

attributes.name: licenseheaders
attributes.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with the **DRM license request only** — the auth token, customer ID or provider-specific header your license server expects. A JSON object string; invalid JSON is ignored with a console warning.

attributes.name: headers
attributes.description: Custom HTTP headers applied to **every** media network request — adaptive-stream manifests *and* their segments (Shaka request filter, hls.js `xhrSetup`, dash.js request interceptor), progressive HTTP, thumbnails, and the encrypted source (stream GET + token refresh). Use it to carry auth tokens, signed-URL headers, or API keys.

attributes.name: audioonly
attributes.description: Data-saver mode — play only the audio and skip the video decode to save CPU and bandwidth. Toggleable live (no reload for muxed/file sources).

attributes.name: lcevc
attributes.description: Enables MPEG-5 Part 2 **LCEVC** enhancement-layer decoding for adaptive streams. Requires the external `lcevc_dec.js` library — point `lcevcurl` at it to lazy-load, or expose a global `LCEVCdec`.

attributes.name: lcevcurl
attributes.description: Enables MPEG-5 Part 2 **LCEVC** enhancement-layer decoding for adaptive streams. Requires the external `lcevc_dec.js` library — point `lcevcurl` at it to lazy-load, or expose a global `LCEVCdec`.

attributes.name: postertime
attributes.description: Generates a native-resolution poster frame from a timestamp instead of (or as a fallback for) `poster`. Useful when you don't have a pre-rendered thumbnail but want to show a representative frame.

attributes.name: vr
attributes.description: Render immersive / spherical video. The player auto-enters the right projection from the source's spherical metadata, so for ordinary 360 clips you don't need this at all — `vr` is for forcing a projection or marking a source whose metadata is missing.

attributes.name: vrpad
attributes.description: Opt-in on-screen joystick for looking around in `vr` mode (handy on touch / without a mouse).

attributes.name: audiooutput
attributes.description: Route audio to a specific output device (speakers, Bluetooth, a virtual device) via `AudioContext.setSinkId`. Accepts a concrete `deviceId` **or** a **label substring** (case-insensitive) — handy because device ids are session-salted, so a substring like `"Headphones"` reliably targets the same physical device across reloads. `""` / `"default"` routes to the system default.

attributes.name: fallback
attributes.description: What to do with a source Movi itself can't play.

attributes.name: engine
attributes.description: Which playback engine leads, and what follows it. Movi has four ways to play a source and, by default, a fixed order: its own WASM demuxer + WebCodecs pipeline first; Shaka (then dash.js / hls.js) for adaptive manifests; the WASM demuxer again as the manifest fallback; the browser's `<video>` last. `engine` re-orders that — the first name listed is attempted first, and any others define what's tried when it fails, replacing the built-in escalation.

attributes.name: wasmurl
attributes.description: URL of the external `movi.wasm`, used only by the **slim build**

attributes.name: persist
attributes.description: Which settings to remember across loads and sessions. Space-separated; nothing

attributes.name: persistkey
attributes.description: Namespaces everything [`persist`](#persist) stores, so two players on a page —

attributes.name: controlslist
attributes.description: Switches built-in controls off, as `no<name>` tokens — the same shape

attributes.name: disablepictureinpicture
attributes.description: Boolean. Refuses Picture-in-Picture, the same as `<video disablepictureinpicture>`:

attributes.name: disableremoteplayback
attributes.description: Boolean. Turns off remote playback targets (AirPlay, Cast) for the element, the same

attributes.name: playlist
attributes.description: A queue. The bar grows Previous and Next, `Shift+P` / `Shift+N` walk it, and the

attributes.name: playlistindex
attributes.description: Which item to open on. Default `0`. The `playlistIndex` property reads and

attributes.name: autoadvance
attributes.description: Let the end of one item start the next. **Off by default** — a queue a page

events.name: abort
events.description: A load was stopped before it had data

events.name: suspend
events.description: Preload settled; no more bytes are being pulled

events.name: encrypted
events.description: The source needs a key; the handshake is starting

events.name: waitingforkey
events.description: Playback is held until the licence lands

events.name: cuechange
events.description: Fired on the TextTrack, not on the element

events.name: loadedmetadata
events.description: Duration and track list are known

events.name: loadeddata
events.description: First frame is decoded and ready to render

events.name: canplay
events.description: Enough data buffered to begin playback

events.name: durationchange
events.description: Duration became known, or was corrected mid-playback

events.name: playing
events.description: Playback actually resumed (after a stall or start)

events.name: canplaythrough
events.description: Buffer reached the end of the media. Unlike <video>, this is not an estimate — it fires only when the rest is genuinely buffered, at most once per source

events.name: stalled
events.description: No data arrived for ~3s while fetching

events.name: emptied
events.description: Previous media torn down; a new load is starting

events.name: resize
events.description: Intrinsic video size changed (i.e. a quality switch)

events.name: error
events.description: Internal player error surfaced to the DOM

events.name: errordisplay
events.description: An error screen went up, with the wording on it. Unlike error, whose payload is the raw Error, this is what the viewer is shown — and it also covers the format/codec failures that raise no runtime error. See Customizing the Error Screen

events.name: volumechange
events.description: Volume or mute toggled (UI, hotkey, or property)

events.name: movi-fullscreen-request
events.description: Cancelable — fires before requestFullscreen(). preventDefault() blocks it so a host can take over via setHostFullscreen()

events.name: itemchange
events.description: Cancelable — the queue moved to another item and is about to load it. preventDefault() takes back the load, not the move, so a host whose sources are <source>/<track> children (or whose items are routes) can own what plays. See Queues the host loads

events.name: playlistend
events.description: The last item ended with nothing after it. Fires whether or not autoadvance is on

events.name: preloadcomplete
events.description: Initial preload buffer filled, ready to play

events.name: linearmode
events.description: Source server ignores Range (200, not 206) — playback is forward-only via a sliding RAM window; hide seek-dependent UI

events.name: filerevoked
events.description: Underlying File handle was revoked by the browser (mobile background / memory pressure). Prompt the user to re-pick.

cssProperties.name: --movi-primary-light
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--movi-primary) 70%, white)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-primary-dark
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--movi-primary) 70%, black)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-bar-bg
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) 45%, transparent 100%)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-overlay-bg
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0%, transparent 12%)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-shadow-sm
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-shadow-md
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-shadow-lg
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `0 16px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-shadow-glow
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--movi-primary) 0.3)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-transition-fast
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-transition-normal
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-transition-slow
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`

cssProperties.name: --movi-transition-bounce
cssProperties.description:
Movi Player theme variable.

Default: `0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)`
